verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API for programmatic access to the platform, covering organizations, teams, and data export, and publishes an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema for the full /api/0/ surface plus a versioning statement and deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe 404s on docs paths are not a contradiction, because the schema is published in the official getsentry repository. Missing for 10: the API is still v0 with beta endpoints subject to change, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically. You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
The official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API"
Our public endpoints are generally stable, but beta endpoints are subject to change.
